_readme: careers.atomico.com (Getro board, the firm's own subdomain), enumerated from sitemap.xml (/companies/<slug>) and parsed from each page's __NEXT_DATA__ by scratch/jobboard-pull.py. stage_board is the board's own field and is NOT a stage label (COLLECTION.md §5, Thrive: 0/10 on the gate).

rows.name: Accurx
rows.description:
Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients. Through one easy-to-use platform, we help everyone involved in a patient’s care to communicate and collaborate.

Whether you’re a patient or a healthcare professional, Accurx lets you connect seamlessly with the people you need to. You can use Accurx to: send SMS messages and medical surveys, provide appointment reminders and referrals, hold video consultations, and manage virtual wards, outpatient clinics, and follow-up pathways.

Accurx is used by 98% of GP practices and in 50% of NHS trusts.

rows.name: Aiven
rows.description: Aiven is a technology-driven company that enables businesses to manage an open-source data infrastructure in the cloud. Headquartered in Helsinki with offices in Berlin, Sydney, Toronto, and Boston, Aiven provides managed open-source data technologies, like PostgreSQL, Kafka, and M3, on all major clouds. It enables its customers to drive business results from open-source that trigger true transformations far beyond their own backyards.

rows.name: Andercore
rows.description: Andercore is an AI-driven B2B trade and distribution platform for industrial supply, operating at the intersection of global sourcing, local distribution, and embedded finance. The company connects vetted global suppliers with local industrial buyers across infrastructure, energy, and building materials. Its proprietary AI platform orchestrates pricing, quoting, financing, and cross-border execution, enabling faster transactions, improved pricing, and reliable delivery at scale. rows.name: Ankar AI
rows.description: Ankar AI operates as a next-generation AI Intellectual Property platform.

rows.name: Ashby
rows.description: Ashby operates as a developer of recruitment software used for high-growth companies. It develops usable, enterprise-grade employment software that enables company leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers to run their hiring process significantly better.

rows.name: Attentive
rows.description: Attentive is the leader in conversational commerce, reinventing business-to-consumer communication. The SMS-first software platform helps everyone from entrepreneurs to enterprises strengthen relationships with their consumers in a new way.

rows.name: Beekeeper
rows.description: Beekeeper is a mobile-first communication platform that reaches every shift, location, and language through real-time messaging and targeted streams. The platform aims to improve employee engagement and retention by automating processes and reducing reliance on paper, thus transforming traditional workplace operations. It connects frontline workers with various operational systems and communication channels, providing them with resources such as schedules and pay stubs.

rows.name: Ben
rows.description: Ben is the all-in-one employee benefits platform for any company to personalize benefits and rewards. Our secret? Marrying a modern software (SaaS) platform with per-employee Mastercards and financial infrastructure. That’s how Ben instantly adds employee choice to your existing benefits, unlocks access to hundreds of additional options through Ben Card, all while saving you time and money.

rows.name: Bitmovin
rows.description:
Bitmovin is a young and dynamic multimedia company. Their principal expertise is in the domain of information and communication technologies for audio-visual networks, in particular for HTTP streaming services and embedded multimedia applications. Additionally, Bitmovin provides consulting and standardization services, specifically towards ISO/IEC MPEG.

rows.name: CADDi

rows.name: Callosum
rows.description:
Callosum provides data analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital engineering services for data management and use. The company develops platforms and tools for data integration, visualization, and machine learning to enable insights across business functions. Its offerings include cloud-based solutions, data governance frameworks, and automation systems that streamline workflows and decision-making processes.

rows.name: ChannelEngine
rows.description:
With a single powerful Software as a Service integration, ChannelEngine connects a seller's systems to international marketplaces and sales channels while optimizing sales, minimizing time, and maximizing profit and reach. It offers brands, distributors, and retailers automated order and return systems, an advanced management suite, and a rich partner ecosystem to bring their sales to the next level.

ChannelEngine empowers companies by creating a seamless integration between businesses and marketplaces. Learn more: www.channelengine.com.

rows.name: CloudNC
rows.description:
CloudNC develops advanced software that enables factories to autonomously manufacture precision parts.

Precision manufacturing is fundamental to every aspect of modern life - without it, there are no cars, aircraft, or ships. No mobile phones or computers. No houses or hospitals, no factories or power plants. No food.

In the modern world, virtually nothing can be made without precision parts. And yet, the manufacturing industry has been slow to modernize and adopt the innovations that are shaping the future.

rows.description: Trusted by leading healthcare providers to enhance millions of patient interactions, with seamless integration into your workflow.

rows.name: DeepL
rows.description: DeepL is a deep learning company using Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) for several language translation products, such as the bilingual dictionary Linguae or the machine translation service DeepL. The company was founded in 2017.

rows.name: Deeploi

rows.name: Dexory
rows.description:
Dexory captures real-time insights of warehouse operations using fully autonomous robots and Artificial Intelligence.

Dexory is paving the way for AI and robotics to completely transform the world of logistics, automating data collection and building digital twin technology that unlocks insights across all levels of warehouse operations. It is a platform that delivers real-time information for the receiving, storing, and dispatch stages, allowing companies unprecedented access to their operations.

The fully autonomous mobile and modular robots measure, track, and find goods across warehouses

rows.name: Digitail
rows.description: Digitail is a veterinary platform for practice management developed by the SC Digitail Innovation company. It allows veterinary doctors and clinic managers to schedule the mandatory visits, send appointment notifications and personalized invoices, as well as give an overview for all the required appointments that the pet should have based on its age and mandatory health scheme.

rows.description: Electric Twin is a technology company that provides tools for creating and interacting with synthetic audiences to support business decision making. It uses data and predictive models to simulate how target consumer groups might behave, allowing evaluation of messaging, product ideas, and market assumptions quickly and interactively. The company’s platform enables organizations to test choices before committing resources and refine strategies based on simulated audience responses. It supports integration of customer data to build tailored simulations and helps teams iterate decisions at speed

rows.name: Factorial
rows.description: Factorial provides business management and human resources software that helps organizations manage employee data, time tracking, payroll processes, recruitment, performance management, expenses, and workforce administration through a unified platform. The platform centralizes HR, finance, and operational workflows, allowing companies to manage employee records, documents, approvals, scheduling, and reporting in one system. rows.name: Framer
rows.description: Framer presents a no-code website builder that allows users to design, publish, and manage custom websites through a visual editing canvas. It includes features such as responsive layouts, animated interactions, live collaboration, integrated CMS, SEO optimization, performance management, and seamless publishing workflows. Framer also provides a community-driven marketplace offering templates, plugins, and components that expand design tools, enable integrations like Notion sync and e-commerce via Frameshop, and support streamlined development workflows.

rows.description: Delivering superhuman co-workers to supercharge your healthcare workforce. rows.description: Healx is a rare disease biotechnology company that uses generative AI for drug discovery. Healx utilizes advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning technologies to identify potential drug candidates and repurpose existing drugs for new therapeutic applications. By focusing on drug repurposing, Healx aims to find new uses for existing medications, leveraging their known safety profiles and reducing the risk and cost associated with developing new drugs from scratch.

rows.name: Hinge Health
rows.description: Hing Health provides digital healthcare alternatives for treating musculoskeletal pain. It offers wearable motion sensors, an application platform, and access to physical therapists, physicians, and health coaches. These solutions assist medical practitioners in providing non-surgical or non-opioid treatments for chronic back or joint pain.

Job&Talent is a world-leading marketplace for essential work. We match great people with great companies through our platform. Technology is our superpower, and we use it to help people find reliable and flexible work. In turn, companies get trusted, agile workforces.

It’s an exciting journey we’re on. Here are some numbers. In 2022, we placed more than 340,000 workers in over 2,500 companies, and we generated €1.9 billion in revenue. rows.name: Lace Lithography

rows.name: Lakera
rows.description: Lakera is a real-time GenAI security company. The company is dedicated to ensuring the safe and responsible development and deployment of artificial intelligence technologies. To accelerate the secure adoption of AI, the company developed Gandalf, an educational tool that has taught over one million users about AI security. Lakera leverages AI to continually evolve its defenses, enabling customers to stay ahead of emerging threats.

rows.name: LendInvest
rows.description: LendInvest operates an online marketplace for property lending and investing. Its online marketplace platform lets everyday investors access various types of asset classes and underwrites and pre-funds various investments. rows.name: Light
rows.description: Light is a financial platform that offers fully automated general ledger and other accounting solution services for multinational companies through software. rows.name: Lime
rows.description: Lime aims to provide a sustainable solution to the first- and last-mile transportation problems by helping people move around their cities in an affordable and convenient way while eliminating their carbon footprint. From the electric scooter to the e-assist and pedal bike, experience the excitement of Lime’s smart mobility fleet.

Its mission is to shift healthcare from reactive treatment to proactive prevention through technology-enabled screening and personalized health insights.

Oh BiBi Games has specialized in racing games. However, the gaming studio also wants to branch out into new genres more connected with PC and console gaming.

Founded in 2012, the company is headquartered in Paris, France.

The platform includes FX liquidity, treasury management, and embedded financial services delivered through APIs to support business operations. Based in Paris, Sorare provides a soccer team management game with digital NFT cards that fans can collect and trade.
